title: regression of R15-UI-094: a local-model narrative written with markdown-bold headers (**TAKE** / **BULL** ...) collapses to a flat summary + insights; business, storyline, bull_case, bear_case and risks come back empty
repro: GET /fundamentals/RELIANCE/narrative with X-LLM-Provider: ollama, X-LLM-Model: llama3.1:8b (own :52843, under the Ollama lock) -> 200 in 32.6s, verified:true; summary holds '**TAKE** ... **BUSINESS** ... **STORYLINE** ... **BULL**', insights end in '**BEAR**' / '**RISKS**', the five typed fields are null/[]. _parse_output's header regex ^([A-Za-z ]+):\s*(.*)$ matches only a plain 'HEADER:' line, so bold or colon-less headers never switch section. One sample; model formatting varies run to run. The fix test (test_five_section_fixture_parses_all_fields) uses a plain fixture only.
